# One Mile at a Time

> > Premium travel blog covering airline loyalty programs, luxury aviation, hotel strategies, and award travel optimization.

One Mile at a Time is a leading travel blog founded by Ben Schlappig, focusing on maximizing frequent flyer miles, luxury air travel experiences, hotel loyalty programs, and premium cabin reviews. The site provides practical guides for award redemptions, status matches, and travel hacking strategies across major programs like American AAdvantage, United MileagePlus, Singapore KrisFlyer, and hotel chains like Hyatt.

## Key Topics

- American AAdvantage
- United Airlines MileagePlus
- Singapore Airlines KrisFlyer
- Star Alliance
- Airbus A380 premium cabins
- Award travel redemptions
- Airline status matches
- Etihad Guest
- Hyatt loyalty program
- Premium cabin features
- Business class reviews
- Travel tax deductions
- Hotel booking strategies
- Luxury aviation
- Miles and points optimization

- [Status Match To Etihad Guest Gold](https://onemileatatime.com/status-match-to-etihad-guest-gold): How to status match to Etihad Guest Gold and benefits overview
- [Use This Trick To Save Money On Hotel Stays](https://onemileatatime.com/use-this-trick-to-save-money-on-hotel-stays): Hotel booking pricing strategy to save money on nightly rates
- [Making Travel Less Taxing: Your Tax Home (Away from Home)](https://onemileatatime.com/making-travel-less-taxing-your-tax-home-away-from-home): Guide to IRS tax home rules and business travel deductions
